subject: Re: Quick follow-up + EoQ priority check (Redwood + NimbusAI)
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.inference>
To: Sophia Lee <sophia.lee@nimbusai.com>, Chris Taylor <chris.taylor@nimbusai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up + recap from our call

Hi Sophia / Chris,

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and suggested next steps: 

- What we heard: main goal is to reduce inference cost for your customer-facing summarization service while keeping tail latency under 250ms 95th percentile. You have an internal latency SLO and are running on mixed GPU instances today.
- Proposed fit: Redwood Dedicated could give you predictable throughput with autoscale and our Optimize recommendations (batching + KV cache) can reduce token cost by ~30% for your workload.
- Data/security: you mentioned SOC2 + VPC requirements; Redwood Private supports customer KMS and audit logs.

Next steps
1) I attached a short product overview and an example mutual action plan (MAP) for technical evaluation.
2) If it looks good, let's schedule a 45-min technical walkthrough with your infra lead (Chris) and our runtime engineer (Marissa).
3) I'll prepare a rough pricing estimate based on the profile you shared.

Are you still targeting an EoQ decision window? If so, any blockers on budget/approval we should be aware of?

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood-Product-Overview.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: NimbusAI-MAP-Response.docx (DOCX)]

From: Sophia Lee <sophia.lee@nimbusai.com>

Cc: Chris Taylor <chris.taylor@nimbusai.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + recap from our call

Hi Aditya,

Appreciate the recap and attachments — skimmed them this morning. A couple quick notes:

- This looks aligned with what we discussed.
- Two immediate asks from my side: can you share a sample sizing estimate for our workload (1k rps peak, avg seq 380 tokens) and a short note on how the KV cache impacts warm-up?

We're hopeful about an EoQ timeline, but approvals need to run through procurement + my VP. I'll loop Chris on the tech walkthrough dates — Chris, can you do a slot next week?

Thanks,
Sophia
Head of Product
NimbusAI

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.inference>
To: Sophia Lee <sophia.lee@nimbusai.com>, Chris Taylor <chris.taylor@nimbusai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + recap from our call

Sophia — thanks. Quick answers inline: 

- Sizing/estimate: attaching a short estimate sheet; ballpark for your profile with Dedicated + 2:1 burst we estimate monthly ~$18k–$24k depending on quantization profile. I'll put exact numbers in a shared sheet if you want to review line-by-line.
- KV cache warm-up: our prefix caching means common conversation prefixes hit immediately; for cold-start under traffic we recommend a short pre-warm pipeline during rollout (details in the attached MAP).

I've proposed a couple 45-min slots for the tech walkthrough in Calendly (link below) — pick what works and I'll send a calendar invite.

Calendly: https://calendly.com/aditya-redwood/45min

If EoQ is still the target, can you confirm decision owner(s) and any approval gates (procurement PO, security review)?

Best,
Aditya
[Attachment: Redwood-Estimate-NimbusAI.xlsx (XLSX)]
